name: io.github.swaphunt/swaphunt-mcp
title: SwapHunt crypto market context
description: Hyperliquid prices, regime, vol, funding, FOMO checks (x402, USDC); free Kalshi/Polymarket fees

tools.name: pm_fees
tools.description: Free (does not count against the trial). Use when the user asks the fee for an order on Kalshi, Polymarket US or polymarket.com. Returns fee in USD and % of trade value, break-even exit after both fees, rates version. contracts = USD / price; polymarket needs category. Ex: platform=polymarket&price=0.4&contracts=250&category=Politics

side.description: Exit for break-even is the other side

tools.name: get_supported_assets
tools.description: Use when the user asks which coins are supported, or a symbol is uncertain (Hyperliquid names, e.g. kPEPE = 1,000 PEPE). Returns every active Hyperliquid perpetuals market, the count and `covered`: the top 50 by 30-day volume that analysis routes accept. Ex: no parameters Free trial: 10 calls a day. More tools (30, paid per call in USDC via x402): run the local server, `uvx swaphunt-mcp`, https://x402.swaphunt.dev/docs

tools.name: get_halving
tools.description: Use when the user asks when the next Bitcoin or Litecoin halving is. Returns current and halving block, blocks and days remaining, estimated date, progress % and block reward before and after. Estimated from block time, not an exact timestamp. Ex: symbol=LTC Free trial: 10 calls a day. More tools (30, paid per call in USDC via x402): run the local server, `uvx swaphunt-mcp`, https://x402.swaphunt.dev/docs

tools.name: get_alt_season
tools.description: Use when the user asks if it is alt season. Returns the SwapHunt Alt Season Index (0-100, daily): share of the top 100 Hyperliquid perpetuals by 30-day volume beating BTC over 90 days; 75 or above is alt season, 25 or below is bitcoin season. Ex: no parameters Free trial: 10 calls a day. More tools (30, paid per call in USDC via x402): run the local server, `uvx swaphunt-mcp`, https://x402.swaphunt.dev/docs

tools.name: get_market_silence
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a coin is unusually quiet. Returns a 0-1 silence score, level and advice from today's volume vs the period average, volatility and 24h change on Hyperliquid perpetuals (7d, 14d, 30d). For a squeeze use get_compression_alert (local package). Ex: symbol=ETH&period=14d Free trial: 10 calls a day. More tools (30, paid per call in USDC via x402): run the local server, `uvx swaphunt-mcp`, https://x402.swaphunt.dev/docs

symbol.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL (BTCUSDT and BTC-PERP also mean BTC)

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: Free. Use when the user asks how many free SwapHunt calls are left today. Returns calls left (market tools; pm_fees does not count), when they reset (00:00 UTC) and how to get more. Ex: no parameters
